task: Add MCP plugin label uniqueness validation, endpoint validation, and multi-MCP test coverage to the preconfigured_assistant creation and update flows.

key_reasoning.reason: Three components touched across two layers: preconfigured_assistants.py (deployment script — two functions modified), AssistantBase.validate_fields() in assistant.py (shared model validation method used on every assistant save path), and the corresponding test file for the deployment script. AssistantBase.validate_fields() is a core shared utility that triggers the red-flag bump from M to L.

Acceptance criteria are concrete (name uniqueness, endpoint validation, >2 MCP test coverage, no regressions), but one behavioral design decision is explicitly open: whether sanitize_for_save() should raise a hard error or emit a warning when called from the deployment script in restricted mode with inline-config templates (affects aws_waf_template.yaml in restricted-mode deployments). This must be decided before implementation to avoid unintended startup failures.
